Wiktionary (for the page that defines the lemma) and Wikidata\n//!    (for the language-neutral Q-item or Lexeme sense). The\n//!    [`MeaningId`] is the semantic meta-language identifier; it never\n//!    embeds any single language.\n//!\n//! 2. **Deformalize** — `deformalize(meaning_id, target_lang)` renders a\n//!    surface form in the target language by:\n//!\n//!    a. running a Wikidata SPARQL lexeme-join (P5137) when the meaning\n//!    is backed by a Wikidata lexeme, **or**\n//!\n//!    b. parsing the source-edition Wiktionary translation table for\n//!    the target language code, **or**\n//!\n//!    c. parsing the target-edition Wiktionary's `=== Перевод ===` /\n//!    `===Translations===` block in reverse.\n//!\n//! Each strategy is recorded as a `provenance` entry on\n//! [`Translation`], so the resulting links-notation trace shows\n//! exactly which API responses fed the answer.\n\nuse super::http::{HttpClient, HttpError};\nuse super::meaning::MeaningId;\nuse super::wikidata::Wikidata;\nuse super::wiktionary::{Wiktionary, WiktionaryCandidate};\n\n/// `true` when `FORMAL_AI_TRANSLATION_DEBUG=1` is set in the environment.\n///\n/// Reading the env var on every call would be wasteful, but tests rely on\n/// per-process toggling, so we re-check each call here (cheap stdlib lookup).\nfn translation_debug_enabled() -> bool {\n    std::env::var(\"FORMAL_AI_TRANSLATION_DEBUG\")\n        .ok()\n        .is_some_and(|value| !value.is_empty() && value != \"0\")\n}\n\n/// Emit a structured debug line to stderr when\n/// `FORMAL_AI_TRANSLATION_DEBUG=1`. Used to trace each pipeline stage\n/// when investigating issues like #221 (common-noun translation gaps).\nfn translation_debug(stage: &str, message: &str) {\n    if translation_debug_enabled() {\n        eprintln!(\"[formal-ai translation] {stage}: {message}\");\n    }\n}\n\n/// Result of a translation request.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub struct Translation {\n    pub source_surface: String,\n    pub source_lang: String,\n    pub target_lang: String,\n    pub meaning: MeaningId,\n    pub candidates: Vec<WiktionaryCandidate>,\n    pub provenance: Vec<String>,\n}\n\nimpl Translation {\n    /// The best target-language surface form. Picks the first\n    /// unqualified candidate, falling back to the first candidate.\n    #[must_use]\n    pub fn primary_surface(&self) -> Option<&str> {\n        self.candidates\n            .iter()\n            .find(|c| c.qualifier.is_none())\n            .or_else(|| self.candidates.first())\n            .map(|c| c.surface.as_str())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Translation pipeline. Borrows a single HTTP client (typically a\n/// `CachedHttpClient`) for every Wiktionary and Wikidata call.\npub struct TranslationPipeline<'a, T: HttpClient + ?Sized> {\n    http: &'a T,\n}\n\nimpl<'a, T: HttpClient + ?Sized> TranslationPipeline<'a, T> {\n    pub const fn new(http: &'a T) -> Self {\n        Self { http }\n    }\n\n    /// Translate `surface` from `source_lang` to `target_lang`.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `Ok(Translation)` even when the candidate list is empty\n    /// — callers can detect translation gaps by inspecting\n    /// [`Translation::candidates`].\n    pub fn translate(\n        &self,\n        surface: &str,\n        source_lang: &str,\n        target_lang: &str,\n    ) -> Result<Translation, HttpError> {\n        if source_lang == target_lang {\n            return Ok(Translation {\n                source_surface: surface.to_owned(),\n                source_lang: source_lang.to_owned(),\n                target_lang: target_lang.to_owned(),\n                meaning: MeaningId::from_wiktionary_page(source_lang, surface),\n                candidates: vec![WiktionaryCandidate {\n                    surface: surface.to_owned(),\n                    qualifier: None,\n                }],\n                provenance: vec![\"identity\".to_owned()],\n            });\n        }\n\n        let mut provenance: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n        let page_title = normalize_page_title(surface);\n\n        // Stage 1: formalize — fetch the source-edition Wiktionary page.\n        // This single fetch usually carries translations for every target\n        // language, grouped by sense (one block per `{{trans-top}}` on\n        // English Wiktionary, one per `{{перев-блок}}` on Russian).\n        let source_wiktionary = Wiktionary::new(source_lang, self.http);\n        let mut blocks: Vec<Vec<WiktionaryCandidate>> = Vec::new();\n        let mut meaning = MeaningId::from_wiktionary_page(source_lang, &page_title);\n        match source_wiktionary.translation_blocks(&page_title, target_lang) {\n            Ok(found) => {\n                provenance.push(format!(\n                    \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{page_title}#translations->{target_lang}\"\n                ));\n                if !found.is_empty() {\n                    blocks = found;\n                }\n            }\n            Err(error) => {\n                provenance.push(format!(\n                    \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{page_title}#translations->error({error})\",\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Stage 1a: many high-traffic pages keep translations on a\n        // `/translations` subpage (`{{see translation subpage|...}}`).\n        // Try that subpage when the main page yielded nothing.\n        if blocks.is_empty() {\n            let subpage = format!(\"{page_title}/translations\");\n            match source_wiktionary.translation_blocks(&subpage, target_lang) {\n                Ok(found) if !found.is_empty() => {\n                    provenance.push(format!(\n                        \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{subpage}#translations->{target_lang}\"\n                    ));\n                    blocks = found;\n                }\n                Ok(_) => {}\n                Err(error) => {\n                    provenance.push(format!(\n                        \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{subpage}#translations->error({error})\",\n                    ));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Stage 1b: when the source-edition table came up empty, try the\n        // target-edition Wiktionary in reverse. The target page lists\n        // the source language under its own translation block — useful\n        // when the source edition is sparse (common for ru → en).\n        if blocks.is_empty() {\n            if let Some(reverse) = reverse_lookup(\n                self.http,\n                surface,\n                source_lang,\n                target_lang,\n                &mut provenance,\n            ) {\n                blocks = reverse;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Stage 1d: phrasal-variant fallback. Some natural phrases don't\n        // have their own Wiktionary entry (e.g. ru:\"как у тебя дела\") but\n        // a shorter canonical form does (ru:\"как дела\"). Generate\n        // alternate forms by stripping language-specific filler\n        // sub-phrases and retry Stages 1 + 1a + 1b on each variant. Stop\n        // at the first variant that produces at least one block.\n        let mut active_page_title = page_title.clone();\n        if blocks.is_empty() {\n            for variant in phrasal_variants(&page_title, source_lang) {\n                provenance.push(format!(\"wiktionary:{source_lang}:variant->{variant}\"));\n                match source_wiktionary.translation_blocks(&variant, target_lang) {\n                    Ok(found) if !found.is_empty() => {\n                        provenance.push(format!(\n                            \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{variant}#translations->{target_lang}\"\n                        ));\n                        blocks = found;\n                        active_page_title.clone_from(&variant);\n                        meaning = MeaningId::from_wiktionary_page(source_lang, &variant);\n                        break;\n                    }\n                    Ok(_) => {}\n                    Err(error) => {\n                        provenance.push(format!(\n                            \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{variant}#translations->error({error})\"\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n                if let Some(reverse) = reverse_lookup(\n                    self.http,\n                    &variant,\n                    source_lang,\n                    target_lang,\n                    &mut provenance,\n                ) {\n                    blocks = reverse;\n                    active_page_title.clone_from(&variant);\n                    meaning = MeaningId::from_wiktionary_page(source_lang, &variant);\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Stage 1c: pick the most likely sense block when the source word\n        // is polysemous (multiple blocks). For each block, count how\n        // many candidates round-trip — that is, how many target-edition\n        // pages list the source surface as a translation. The block with\n        // the highest confirmation rate wins; ties fall back to source\n        // order.\n        let candidates = if blocks.is_empty() {\n            Vec::new()\n        } else {\n            select_best_block(\n                self.http,\n                &active_page_title,\n                source_lang,\n                target_lang,\n                &mut provenance,\n                blocks,\n            )\n        };\n\n        // Stage 2: pull the Wikidata Q-item / Lexeme sense — even if\n        // we already have a translation surface, we want the trace to\n        // expose the canonical meaning id. Failures here do not block\n        // the translation.\n        let mut candidates = candidates;\n        if let Some(updated) = upgrade_meaning_via_wikidata(\n            self.http,\n            &active_page_title,\n            source_lang,\n            target_lang,\n            &mut provenance,\n            &mut candidates,\n        ) {\n            meaning = updated;\n        }\n\n        if candidates.is_empty() {\n            candidates = compositional_candidates(\n                &active_page_title,\n                source_lang,\n                target_lang,\n                &mut provenance,\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(Translation {\n            source_surface: surface.to_owned(),\n            source_lang: source_lang.to_owned(),\n            target_lang: target_lang.to_owned(),\n            meaning,\n            candidates,\n            provenance,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n/// Try the target-edition Wiktionary in reverse. We open the page that\n/// is most likely to *exist* on the target edition for the source word.\n/// Russian Wiktionary, for instance, hosts pages for Russian words and\n/// records their translations into other languages under\n/// `=== Перевод ===`.\nfn reverse_lookup<T: HttpClient + ?Sized>(\n    http: &T,\n    surface: &str,\n    source_lang: &str,\n    target_lang: &str,\n    provenance: &mut Vec<String>,\n) -> Option<Vec<Vec<WiktionaryCandidate>>> {\n    let page_title = normalize_page_title(surface);\n    for edition in [source_lang, target_lang] {\n        let wiktionary = Wiktionary::new(edition, http);\n        match wiktionary.translation_blocks(&page_title, target_lang) {\n            Ok(blocks) if !blocks.is_empty() => {\n                provenance.push(format!(\n                    \"wiktionary:{edition}:{page_title}#reverse->{target_lang}\"\n                ));\n                return Some(blocks);\n            }\n            Ok(_) => {}\n            Err(error) => {\n                provenance.push(format!(\n                    \"wiktionary:{edition}:{page_title}#reverse->error({error})\"\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n\n/// Pick the best sense block from `blocks` by round-trip confirmation rate.\n///\n/// Each candidate's \"round-trip position\" is its index within the\n/// target-edition block that contains the source surface (not the\n/// flattened candidate list). Lower position = the target considers the\n/// source more primary.\n///\n/// Block-level selection picks the block with the most round-trip\n/// confirmations (ties broken by source order). Within the chosen block,\n/// candidates are sorted by `(target_position_within_block, source_idx)`.\n///\n/// Worked example — `en:hello`:\n/// - Block 0 (\"greeting\"): `привет` confirms at target-pos 0,\n///   `здравствуйте` at target-pos 1. Two confirms.\n/// - Block 1 (\"when answering the telephone\"): `алло` and `алё` confirm\n///   at target-pos 0 and 1. Two confirms.\n/// - Ties go to the earlier source block → block 0. Within block 0,\n///   `привет` (target-pos 0) beats `здравствуйте` (target-pos 1).\nfn select_best_block<T: HttpClient + ?Sized>(\n    http: &T,\n    page_title: &str,\n    source_lang: &str,\n    target_lang: &str,\n    provenance: &mut Vec<String>,\n    blocks: Vec<Vec<WiktionaryCandidate>>,\n) -> Vec<WiktionaryCandidate> {\n    let target_wiktionary = Wiktionary::new(target_lang, http);\n    let mut block_positions: Vec<Vec<Option<usize>>> = Vec::with_capacity(blocks.len());\n    for (block_idx, block) in blocks.iter().enumerate() {\n        let mut positions: Vec<Option<usize>> = Vec::with_capacity(block.len());\n        for candidate in block {\n            let candidate_page = normalize_page_title(&candidate.surface);\n            if candidate_page.is_empty() {\n                positions.push(None);\n                continue;\n            }\n            let Ok(back_blocks) =\n                target_wiktionary.translation_blocks(&candidate_page, source_lang)\n            else {\n                positions.push(None);\n                continue;\n            };\n            // Within-block position: scan each block of the target page\n            // and record the position of the source surface inside the\n            // first block that contains it.\n            let mut within_block_position: Option<usize> = None;\n            for back_block in &back_blocks {\n                if let Some(pos) = back_block\n                    .iter()\n                    .position(|row| normalize_page_title(&row.surface) == page_title)\n                {\n                    within_block_position = Some(pos);\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(pos) = within_block_position {\n                provenance.push(format!(\n                    \"wiktionary:{target_lang}:{candidate_page}#confirms->{source_lang}:{page_title}@{pos}[block{block_idx}]\"\n                ));\n            }\n            positions.push(within_block_position);\n        }\n        block_positions.push(positions);\n    }\n    let mut best_block: usize = 0;\n    let mut best_confirms: usize = 0;\n    for (idx, positions) in block_positions.iter().enumerate() {\n        let confirms = positions.iter().filter(|p| p.is_some()).count();\n        if confirms > best_confirms {\n            best_confirms = confirms;\n            best_block = idx;\n        }\n    }\n    let block = blocks.into_iter().nth(best_block).unwrap_or_default();\n    let positions = block_positions\n        .into_iter()\n        .nth(best_block)\n        .unwrap_or_default();\n    let mut indexed: Vec<(usize, Option<usize>, WiktionaryCandidate)> = block\n        .into_iter()\n        .zip(positions)\n        .enumerate()\n        .map(|(idx, (cand, pos))| (idx, pos, cand))\n        .collect();\n    indexed.sort_by_key(|(idx, pos, _)| {\n        pos.as_ref()\n            .map_or((1usize, 0, *idx), |p| (0usize, *p, *idx))\n    });\n    indexed.into_iter().map(|(_, _, cand)| cand).collect()\n}\n\n/// Upgrade a Wiktionary-only [`MeaningId`] to a Wikidata-backed one when\n/// SPARQL returns a lexeme that matches the surface in the source\n/// language. Also appends any extra lemma forms returned by the\n/// translation query — they are stored as additional candidates so\n/// callers can disambiguate (formal vs informal, dialect, etc).\nfn upgrade_meaning_via_wikidata<T: HttpClient + ?Sized>(\n    http: &T,\n    page_title: &str,\n    source_lang: &str,\n    target_lang: &str,\n    provenance: &mut Vec<String>,\n    candidates: &mut Vec<WiktionaryCandidate>,\n) -> Option<MeaningId> {\n    let wikidata = Wikidata::new(http);\n    let hits = match wikidata.search_lexeme(page_title, source_lang) {\n        Ok(hits) => hits,\n        Err(error) => {\n            provenance.push(format!(\"wikidata:search->error({error})\"));\n            return None;\n        }\n    };\n    let first = hits.first()?;\n    provenance.push(format!(\"wikidata:lexeme:{}\", first.id));\n    let lemmas = match wikidata.lexeme_translations(&first.id, target_lang) {\n        Ok(rows) => rows,\n        Err(error) => {\n            provenance.push(format!(\"wikidata:sparql->error({error})\"));\n            return Some(MeaningId::from_sense(first.id.clone()));\n        }\n    };\n    if !lemmas.is_empty() {\n        provenance.push(format!(\n            \"wikidata:sparql:{}->{} ({} lemmas)\",\n            first.id,\n            target_lang,\n            lemmas.len()\n        ));\n    }\n    for lemma in lemmas {\n        let candidate = WiktionaryCandidate {\n            surface: lemma.value,\n            qualifier: None,\n        };\n        if !candidates.iter().any(|c| c.surface == candidate.surface) {\n            candidates.push(candidate);\n        }\n    }\n    Some(MeaningId::from_sense(first.id.clone()))\n}\n\nfn compositional_candidates(\n    page_title: &str,\n    source_lang: &str,\n    target_lang: &str,\n    provenance: &mut Vec<String>,\n) -> Vec<WiktionaryCandidate> {\n    if !source_lang.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"ru\") || !target_lang.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"en\") {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    if let Some(surface) = russian_phrase_to_english(page_title) {\n        provenance.push(format!(\"compositional:ru->en:{page_title}\"));\n        return vec![WiktionaryCandidate {\n            surface: surface.to_owned(),\n            qualifier: None,\n        }];\n    }\n\n    let words: Vec<&str> = page_title.split_whitespace().collect();\n    if !(2..=4).contains(&words.len()) {\n        return Vec::new();\n    }\n\n    let mut translated = Vec::with_capacity(words.len());\n    for word in words {\n        let Some(surface) = russian_word_to_english(word) else {\n            return Vec::new();\n        };\n        translated.push(surface);\n    }\n\n    let surface = capitalize_ascii_first(&translated.join(\" \"));\n    provenance.push(format!(\"compositional:ru->en:{page_title}\"));\n    vec![WiktionaryCandidate {\n        surface,\n        qualifier: None,\n    }]\n}\n\nfn russian_phrase_to_english(page_title: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {\n    match page_title {\n        \"кто ты\" | \"кто ты такой\" | \"кто ты такая\" | \"кто вы\" | \"кто вы такой\" | \"кто вы такая\" => {\n            Some(\"Who are you?\")\n        }\n        \"что это\" | \"что это такое\" => Some(\"What is this?\"),\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\nfn russian_word_to_english(word: &str) -> Option<&'static str> {\n    match word {\n        \"доброе\" | \"добрый\" | \"добрая\" | \"добрые\" | \"доброго\" | \"добрую\" | \"добрым\" | \"хорошее\"\n        | \"хороший\" | \"хорошая\" | \"хорошие\" | \"хорошего\" | \"хорошую\" | \"хорошим\" => {\n            Some(\"good\")\n        }\n        \"яблоко\" | \"яблока\" | \"яблоку\" | \"яблоком\" | \"яблоке\" | \"яблоки\" | \"яблок\" | \"яблокам\"\n        | \"яблоками\" | \"яблоках\" => Some(\"apple\"),\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\nfn capitalize_ascii_first(surface: &str) -> String {\n    let mut chars = surface.chars();\n    let Some(first) = chars.next() else {\n        return String::new();\n    };\n    let mut out = String::with_capacity(surface.len());\n    out.extend(first.to_uppercase());\n    out.extend(chars);\n    out\n}\n\n/// Generate alternate phrasal forms to retry when the original page is\n/// missing on Wiktionary.\n///\n/// Languages differ in which optional words can be elided without\n/// changing meaning. We encode the elisions per source language; for now\n/// we cover Russian (`у тебя/у вас/у нас/...` infix between question word\n/// and noun).\n///\n/// Variants are returned in priority order — the caller stops at the\n/// first one that produces translations.\n#[must_use]\npub fn phrasal_variants(page_title: &str, source_lang: &str) -> Vec<String> {\n    let mut variants: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n    if source_lang.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"ru\") {\n        // Russian dative-of-possession infix: `как у тебя дела` and\n        // `как у вас дела` collapse to the canonical `как дела`. This\n        // covers the politeness variants without changing semantics.\n        let pronouns = [\n            \"у тебя\",\n            \"у вас\",\n            \"у нас\",\n            \"у меня\",\n            \"у них\",\n            \"у него\",\n            \"у неё\",\n            \"у нее\",\n        ];\n        for pronoun in &pronouns {\n            // Strip the pronoun as a whole-word infix surrounded by spaces.\n            let needle = format!(\" {pronoun} \");\n            if let Some(idx) = page_title.find(&needle) {\n                let mut alt = String::with_capacity(page_title.len() - needle.len() + 1);\n                alt.push_str(&page_title[..idx]);\n                alt.push(' ');\n                alt.push_str(&page_title[idx + needle.len()..]);\n                let alt = alt.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(\" \");\n                if !alt.is_empty() && alt != page_title && !variants.contains(&alt) {\n                    variants.push(alt);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    variants\n}\n\n/// Normalize a surface fragment into a Wiktionary page title.\n///\n/// - Trim whitespace.\n/// - Strip terminal punctuation (`?`, `!`, `.`, `。`, `？`, `！`).\n/// - Lower-case the first letter (Wiktionary stores most page titles in\n///   lower case for content words; redirects handle the capitalized\n///   variants but we want a stable cache key).\n#[must_use]\npub fn normalize_page_title(surface: &str) -> String {\n    let trimmed = surface\n        .trim()\n        .trim_end_matches(['?', '!', '.', '。', '？', '！', '．']);\n    let mut chars = trimmed.chars();\n    let Some(first) = chars.next() else {\n        return String::new();\n    };\n    let mut out = String::with_capacity(trimmed.len());\n    for character in first.to_lowercase() {\n        out.push(character);\n    }\n    out.extend(chars);\n    out\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use [2026-05-21T23:37:16.142Z] [INFO]     "originalFile": "//! Translation pipeline.\n//!\n//! Public entry point: [`TranslationPipeline::translate`].\n//!\n//! ## Stages\n//!\n//! 1. **Formalize** — `formalize(source_surface, source_lang)` projects the\n//!    natural-language surface into a [`MeaningId`] by consulting\n//!    Wiktionary (for the page that defines the lemma) and Wikidata\n//!    (for the language-neutral Q-item or Lexeme sense). The\n//!    [`MeaningId`] is the semantic meta-language identifier; it never\n//!    embeds any single language.\n//!\n//! 2. **Deformalize** — `deformalize(meaning_id, target_lang)` renders a\n//!    surface form in the target language by:\n//!\n//!    a. running a Wikidata SPARQL lexeme-join (P5137) when the meaning\n//!    is backed by a Wikidata lexeme, **or**\n//!\n//!    b. parsing the source-edition Wiktionary translation table for\n//!    the target language code, **or**\n//!\n//!    c. parsing the target-edition Wiktionary's `=== Перевод ===` /\n//!    `===Translations===` block in reverse.\n//!\n//! T,\n}\n\nimpl<'a, T: HttpClient + ?Sized> TranslationPipeline<'a, T> {\n    pub const fn new(http: &'a T) -> Self {\n        Self { http }\n    }\n\n    /// Translate `surface` from `source_lang` to pub fn translate(\n        &self,\n        surface: &str,\n        source_lang: &str,\n        target_lang: &str,\n    ) -> Result<Translation, HttpError> {\n        translation_debug(\n            \"translate\",\n            &format!(\"start surface={surface:?} {source_lang}->{target_lang}\"),\n        );\n        if source_lang == target_lang {\n            translation_debug(\"translate\", \"identity (source==target)\");\n            return Ok(Translation {\n                source_surface: surface.to_owned(),\n                source_lang: source_lang.to_owned(),\n                target_lang: target_lang.to_owned(),\n                meaning: MeaningId::from_wiktionary_page(source_lang, surface),\n                candidates: vec![WiktionaryCandidate {\n                    surface: surface.to_owned(),\n                    qualifier: None,\n                }],\n                provenance: vec![\"identity\".to_owned()],\n            });\n        }\n\n        let mut provenance: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n        let page_title = normalize_page_title(surface);\n        translation_debug(\"translate\", &format!(\"page_title={page_title:?}\"));\n\n        // Stage 1: formalize — fetch the source-edition Wiktionary page.\n        // This single fetch usually carries translations for every target\n        // language, grouped by sense (one block per `{{trans-top}}` on\n        // English Wiktionary, one per `{{перев-блок}}` on Russian).\n        let source_wiktionary = Wiktionary::new(source_lang, self.http);\n        let mut blocks: Vec<Vec<WiktionaryCandidate>> = Vec::new();\n        let mut meaning = MeaningId::from_wiktionary_page(source_lang, &page_title);\n        match source_wiktionary.translation_blocks(&page_title, target_lang) {\n            Ok(found) => {\n                provenance.push(format!(\n                    \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{page_title}#translations->{target_lang}\"\n                ));\n                if !found.is_empty() {\n                    blocks = found;\n                }\n            }\n            Err(error) => {\n                provenance.push(format!(\n                    \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{page_title}#translations->error({error})\",\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Stage 1a: many high-traffic pages keep translations on a\n        // `/translations` subpage (`{{see translation subpage|...}}`).\n        // Try that subpage when the main page yielded nothing.\n        if blocks.is_empty() {\n            let subpage = format!(\"{page_title}/translations\");\n            match source_wiktionary.translation_blocks(&subpage, target_lang) {\n                Ok(found) if !found.is_empty() => {\n                    provenance.push(format!(\n                        \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{subpage}#translations->{target_lang}\"\n                    ));\n                    blocks = found;\n                }\n                Ok(_) => {}\n                Err(error) => {\n                    provenance.push(format!(\n                        \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{subpage}#translations->error({error})\",\n                    ));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Stage 1b: when the source-edition table came up empty, try the\n        // target-edition Wiktionary in reverse. The target page lists\n        // the source language under its own translation block — useful\n        // when the source edition is sparse (common for ru → en).\n        if blocks.is_empty() {\n            if let Some(reverse) = reverse_lookup(\n                self.http,\n                surface,\n                source_lang,\n                target_lang,\n                &mut provenance,\n            ) {\n                blocks = reverse;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Stage 1d: phrasal-variant fallback. Some natural phrases don't\n        // have their own Wiktionary entry (e.g. ru:\"как у тебя дела\") but\n        // a shorter canonical form does (ru:\"как дела\"). Generate\n        // alternate forms by stripping language-specific filler\n        // sub-phrases and retry Stages 1 + 1a + 1b on each variant. Stop\n        // at the first variant that produces at least one block.\n        let mut active_page_title = page_title.clone();\n        if blocks.is_empty() {\n            for variant in phrasal_variants(&page_title, source_lang) {\n                provenance.push(format!(\"wiktionary:{source_lang}:variant->{variant}\"));\n                match source_wiktionary.translation_blocks(&variant, target_lang) {\n                    Ok(found) if !found.is_empty() => {\n                        provenance.push(format!(\n                            \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{variant}#translations->{target_lang}\"\n                        ));\n                        blocks = found;\n                        active_page_title.clone_from(&variant);\n                        meaning = MeaningId::from_wiktionary_page(source_lang, &variant);\n                        break;\n                    }\n                    Ok(_) => {}\n                    Err(error) => {\n                        provenance.push(format!(\n                            \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{variant}#translations->error({error})\"\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n                if let Some(reverse) = reverse_lookup(\n                    self.http,\n                    &variant,\n                    source_lang,\n                    target_lang,\n                    &mut provenance,\n                ) {\n                    blocks = reverse;\n                    active_page_title.clone_from(&variant);\n                    meaning = MeaningId::from_wiktionary_page(source_lang, &variant);\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Stage 1c: pick the most likely sense block when the source word\n        // is polysemous (multiple blocks). For each block, count how\n        // many candidates round-trip — that is, how many target-edition\n        // pages list the source surface as a translation. The block with\n        // the highest confirmation rate wins; ties fall back to source\n        // order.\n        let candidates = if blocks.is_empty() {\n            Vec::new()\n        } else {\n            select_best_block(\n                self.http,\n                &active_page_title,\n                source_lang,\n                target_lang,\n                &mut provenance,\n                blocks,\n            )\n        };\n\n        // Stage 2: pull the Wikidata Q-item / Lexeme sense — even if\n        // we already have a translation surface, we want the trace to\n        // expose the canonical meaning id. Failures here do not block\n        // the translation.\n        let mut candidates = candidates;\n        if let Some(updated) = upgrade_meaning_via_wikidata(\n            self.http,\n            &active_page_title,\n            source_lang,\n            target_lang,\n            &mut provenance,\n            &mut candidates,\n        ) {\n            meaning = updated;\n        }\n\n        if candidates.is_empty() {\n            candidates = compositional_candidates(\n                &active_page_title,\n                source_lang,\n                target_lang,\n                &mut provenance,\n            );\n        }\n\n        Ok(Translation {\n            source_surface: surface.to_owned(),\n            source_lang: source_lang.to_owned(),\n            target_lang: target_lang.to_owned(),\n            meaning,\n            candidates,\n            provenance,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\n/// Try the target-edition Wiktionary in reverse. We open the page that\n/// is most likely to *exist* on the target edition for the source word.\n/// Russian Wiktionary, for instance, hosts pages for Russian words and\n/// records their translations into other languages under\n/// `=== Перевод ===`.\nfn reverse_lookup<T: HttpClient + ?Sized>(\n    http: &T,\n    surface: &str,\n    source_lang: &str,\n    target_lang: &str,\n    provenance: &mut Vec<String>,\n) -> Option<Vec<Vec<WiktionaryCandidate>>> {\n    let page_title = normalize_page_title(surface);\n    for edition in [source_lang, target_lang] {\n        let wiktionary = Wiktionary::new(edition, http);\n        match wiktionary.translation_blocks(&page_title, target_lang) {\n            Ok(blocks) if !blocks.is_empty() => {\n                provenance.push(format!(\n                    \"wiktionary:{edition}:{page_title}#reverse->{target_lang}\"\n                ));\n                return Some(blocks);\n            }\n            Ok(_) => {}\n            Err(error) => {\n                provenance.push(format!(\n                    \"wiktionary:{edition}:{page_title}#reverse->error({error})\"\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n\n/// Pick the best sense block from `blocks` by round-trip confirmation rate.\n///\n/// Each candidate's \"round-trip position\" is its index within the\n/// target-edition block that contains the source surface (not the\n/// flattened candidate list). Lower position = the target considers the\n/// source more primary.\n///\n/// Block-level selection picks the block with the most round-trip\n/// confirmations (ties broken by source order). Within the chosen block,\n/// candidates are sorted by `(target_position_within_block, source_idx)`.\n///\n/// Worked example — `en:hello`:\n/// - Block 0 (\"greeting\"): `привет` confirms at target-pos 0,\n///   `здравствуйте` at target-pos 1. Two confirms.\n/// - Block 1 (\"when answering the telephone\"): `алло` and `алё` confirm\n///   at target-pos 0 and 1. Two confirms.\n/// - Ties go to the earlier source block → block 0. Within block 0,\n///   `привет` (target-pos 0) beats `здравствуйте` (target-pos 1).\nfn select_best_block<T: HttpClient + ?Sized>(\n    http: &T,\n    page_title: &str,\n    source_lang: &str,\n    target_lang: &str,\n    provenance: &mut Vec<String>,\n    blocks: Vec<Vec<WiktionaryCandidate>>,\n) -> Vec<WiktionaryCandidate> {\n    let target_wiktionary = Wiktionary::new(target_lang, http);\n    let mut block_positions: Vec<Vec<Option<usize>>> = Vec::with_capacity(blocks.len());\n    for (block_idx, block) in blocks.iter().enumerate() {\n        let mut positions: Vec<Option<usize>> = Vec::with_capacity(block.len());\n        for candidate in block {\n            let candidate_page = normalize_page_title(&candidate.surface);\n            if candidate_page.is_empty() {\n                positions.push(None);\n                continue;\n            }\n            let Ok(back_blocks) =\n                target_wiktionary.translation_blocks(&candidate_page, source_lang)\n            else {\n                positions.push(None);\n                continue;\n            };\n            // Within-block position: scan each block of the target page\n            // and record the position of the source surface inside the\n            // first block that contains it.\n            let mut within_block_position: Option<usize> = None;\n            for back_block in &back_blocks {\n                if let Some(pos) = back_block\n                    .iter()\n                    .position(|row| normalize_page_title(&row.surface) == page_title)\n                {\n                    within_block_position = Some(pos);\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n            if let Some(pos) = within_block_position {\n                provenance.push(format!(\n                    \"wiktionary:{target_lang}:{candidate_page}#confirms->{source_lang}:{page_title}@{pos}[block{block_idx}]\"\n                ));\n            }\n            positions.push(within_block_position);\n        }\n        block_positions.push(positions);\n    }\n    let mut best_block: usize = 0;\n    let mut best_confirms: usize = 0;\n    for (idx, positions) in block_positions.iter().enumerate() {\n        let confirms = positions.iter().filter(|p| p.is_some()).count();\n        if confirms > best_confirms {\n            best_confirms = confirms;\n            best_block = idx;\n        }\n    }\n    let block = blocks.into_iter().nth(best_block).unwrap_or_default();\n    let positions = block_positions\n        .into_iter()\n        .nth(best_block)\n        .unwrap_or_default();\n    let mut indexed: Vec<(usize, Option<usize>, WiktionaryCandidate)> = block\n        .into_iter()\n        .zip(positions)\n        .enumerate()\n        .map(|(idx, (cand, pos))| (idx, pos, cand))\n        .collect();\n    indexed.sort_by_key(|(idx, pos, _)| {\n        pos.as_ref()\n            .map_or((1usize, 0, *idx), |p| (0usize, *p, *idx))\n    });\n    indexed.into_iter().map(|(_, _, cand)| cand).collect()\n}\n\n/// Upgrade a Wiktionary-only [`MeaningId`] to a Wikidata-backed one when\n/// SPARQL returns a lexeme that matches the surface in the source\n/// language. Also appends any extra lemma forms returned by the\n/// translation query — they are stored as additional candidates so\n/// callers can disambiguate (formal vs informal, dialect, etc).\nfn upgrade_meaning_via_wikidata<T: HttpClient + ?Sized>(\n    http: &T,\n    page_title: &str,\n    source_lang: &str,\n    target_lang: &str,\n    provenance: &mut Vec<String>,\n    candidates: &mut Vec<WiktionaryCandidate>,\n) -> Option<MeaningId> {\n    let wikidata = Wikidata::new(http);\n    let hits = match wikidata.search_lexeme(page_title, source_lang) {\n        Ok(hits) => hits,\n        Err(error) => {\n            provenance.push(format!(\"wikidata:search->error({error})\"));\n            return None;\n        }\n    };\n    let first = hits.first()?;\n    provenance.push(format!(\"wikidata:lexeme:{}\", first.id));\n    let lemmas = match wikidata.lexeme_translations(&first.id, target_lang) {\n        Ok(rows) => rows,\n        Err(error) => {\n            provenance.push(format!(\"wikidata:sparql->error({error})\"));\n            return Some(MeaningId::from_sense(first.id.clone()));\n        }\n    };\n    if !lemmas.is_empty() {\n        provenance.push(format!(\n            \"wikidata:sparql:{}->{} ({} lemmas)\",\n            first.id,\n            target_lang,\n            lemmas.len()\n        ));\n    }\n    for lemma in lemmas pub fn translate(\n        &self,\n        surface: &str,\n        source_lang: &str,\n        target_lang: &str,\n    ) -> Result<Translation, HttpError> {\n        translation_debug(\n The target page lists\n        // the source language under its own translation block — useful\n        // when the source edition is sparse (common for ru → en).\n        if blocks.is_empty() {\n            if let Some(reverse) = reverse_lookup(\n                self.http,\n                surface,\n                source_lang,\n                target_lang,\n                &mut provenance,\n            ) {\n                blocks = reverse;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Stage 1d: phrasal-variant fallback. Stop\n        // at the first variant that produces at least one block.\n        let mut active_page_title = page_title.clone();\n        if blocks.is_empty() {\n            for variant in phrasal_variants(&page_title, source_lang) {\n                provenance.push(format!(\"wiktionary:{source_lang}:variant->{variant}\"));\n                match source_wiktionary.translation_blocks(&variant, target_lang) {\n                    Ok(found) if !found.is_empty() => {\n                        provenance.push(format!(\n                            \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{variant}#translations->{target_lang}\"\n                        ));\n                        blocks = found;\n                        active_page_title.clone_from(&variant);\n                        meaning = MeaningId::from_wiktionary_page(source_lang, &variant);\n                        break;\n                    }\n                    Ok(_) => {}\n                    Err(error) => {\n                        provenance.push(format!(\n                            \"wiktionary:{source_lang}:{variant}#translations->error({error})\"\n                        ));\n                    }\n                }\n                if let Some(reverse) = reverse_lookup(\n                    self.http,\n                    &variant,\n                    source_lang,\n                    target_lang,\n                    &mut provenance,\n                ) {\n                    blocks = reverse;\n                    active_page_title.clone_from(&variant);\n                    meaning = MeaningId::from_wiktionary_page(source_lang, &variant);\n                    break;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Stage 1c: pick the most likely sense block when the source word\n        // is polysemous (multiple blocks). target_lang: &str,\n    provenance: &mut Vec<String>,\n    blocks: Vec<Vec<WiktionaryCandidate>>,\n) -> Vec<WiktionaryCandidate> {\n    let target_wiktionary = Wiktionary::new(target_lang, http);\n    positions.push(None);\n                continue;\n            }\n            let Ok(back_blocks) =\n                target_wiktionary.translation_blocks(&candidate_page, source_lang)\n indexed.into_iter().map(|(_, _, cand)| cand).collect()\n}\n\n/// Upgrade a Wiktionary-only [`MeaningId`] to a Wikidata-backed one when\n/// SPARQL returns a lexeme that matches the surface in the 2] &&\n        left[i - 2] === right[j - 1]\n      ) {\n        dp[i][j] = Math.min(dp[i][j], dp[i - 2][j - 2] + 1);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return dp[m][n];\n}\n\nfunction isCloseTokenTypo(actual, expected) {\n  const left = String(actual || \"\").toLowerCase();\n  const right = String(expected || \"\").toLowerCase();\n  const leftLength = Array.from(left).length;\n  const rightLength = Array.from(right).length;\n  return Math.min(leftLength, rightLength) >= 4 && editDistance(left, right) === 1;\n}\n\nfunction leadingTokenSpans(value, limit) {\n  const text = String(value || \"\");\n  const spans = [];\n  const pattern = /\\S+/gu;\n  let match;\n  while ((match = pattern.exec(text)) !== null && spans.length < limit) {\n    spans.push({\n      start: match.index,\n      end: match.index + match[0].length,\n      text: match[0],\n    });\n  }\n  return spans;\n}\n\nfunction fuzzyPrefixMatch(value, prefix) {\n  const words = String(prefix || \"\").trim().split(/\\s+/u).filter(Boolean);\n  if (words.length === 0) return null;\n  const spans = leadingTokenSpans(value, words.length);\n  if (spans.length !== words.length) return null;\n  let typoCount = 0;\n  for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i += 1) {\n    const actual = spans[i].text;\n    const expected = words[i];\n    if (actual.toLowerCase() === expected.toLowerCase()) continue;\n    if (!isCloseTokenTypo(actual, expected)) return null;\n    typoCount += 1;\n  }\n  if (typoCount !== 1) return null;\n  const end = spans[spans.length - 1].end;\n  return {\n    typoCount,\n    end,\n    interpretation: {\n      original: String(value || \"\").slice(0, end),\n      corrected: String(prefix || \"\").trim(),\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction stripKnownPrefix(value, prefixes) {\n  const text = String(value || \"\");\n  const lower = text.toLowerCase();\n  for (const prefix of prefixes) {\n    if (lower.startsWith(prefix)) {\n      return { value: text.slice(prefix.length).trimStart(), interpretation: null };\n    }\n  }\n  const matches = prefixes\n    .map((prefix) => fuzzyPrefixMatch(text, prefix))\n    .filter(Boolean)\n    .sort((left, right) =>\n      left.typoCount - Browser-friendly: CORS is\n// enabled by Wikimedia for these summary endpoints, so the worker can fetch\n// without a proxy from GitHub Pages.\nconst WIKIPEDIA_HOSTS = {\n  en: \"https://en.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary\",\n  ru: \"https://ru.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary\",\n  hi: \"https://hi.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary\",\n  zh: \"https://zh.wikipedia.org/api/rest_v1/page/summary\",\n};\n\n// Wikipedia full-text page search endpoint per language (CORS-enabled). 0 : 1;\n      const next = Math.min(\n        previous[j] + 1,\n        current[j - 1] + 1,\n        previous[j - 1] + cost,\n      );\n      current[j] = next;\n      rowMin = Math.min(rowMin, next);\n    }\n    if (rowMin > limit) return limit + 1;\n    previous = current;\n  }\n  return previous[right.length];\n}\n\nfunction isNearLookupText(left, right) {\n  const a = compactLookupText(left);\n  const b = compactLookupText(right);\n  if (!a || !b) return false;\n  const maxLength = Math.max(a.length, b.length);\n  const limit = maxLength <= 8 ? 1 : 2;\n  return boundedEditDistance(a, b, limit) <= limit;\n}\n\nfunction isPlausibleWikipediaSearchMatch(summary, term) {\n  if (\n    !summary ||\n    (summary.matchKind !== \"search\" && summary.matchKind !== \"context_search\")\n  ) {\n    return true;\n  }\n  const termNormalized = normalizeLookupText(term);\n  if (!termNormalized) return true;\n  const termTokens = termNormalized.split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n  const candidates = [\n    summary.title,\n    summary.matchedTitle,\n    String(summary.matchedSlug || \"\").replace(/_/g, \" \"),\n    summary.extract,\n  ];\n  for (const candidate of candidates) {\n    const normalized = normalizeLookupText(candidate);\n    if (!normalized) continue;\n    if (normalized === termNormalized) return true;\n    const candidateTokens = new Set(normalized.split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean));\n    if (\n      termTokens.length > 0 &&\n      termTokens.every((token) => candidateTokens.has(token))\n    ) {\n      return true;\n    }\n    if (isNearLookupText(termNormalized, normalized)) return true;\n  }\n  return false;\n}\n\n// Resolve a context-qualified term to a Wikipedia page slug via full-text page\n// search. plain term with context is the fallback.\n  const queries = [];\n  if (upper !== term) queries.push(`${upper} ${context}`.trim());\n  queries.push(`${term} ${context}`.trim());\n  const ordered = [language, \"en\"].filter(\n    (value, index, array) => value && array.indexOf(value) === index,\n  );\n  for (const lang of ordered) {\n    const base = WIKIPEDIA_SEARCH_HOSTS[lang] || WIKIPEDIA_SEARCH_HOSTS.en;\n    for (const query of queries) {\n      const url = `${base}?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=5`;\n      try {\n        const response = await fetch(url, { headers: apiHeaders });\n        if (!response || !response.ok) continue;\n        const data = await response.json();\n        if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.pages) || data.pages.length === 0)\n          continue;\n        // Return the key of the top result; callers will fetch the full summary.\n        const page = data.pages[0];\n        return {\n          slug: page.key,\n          title: page.title || page.key,\n          language: lang,\n          query,\n        };\n      } catch (_error) {\n        // Ignore and try next query / language host.\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\nasync function fetchWikipediaSummary(term, language, context) {\n  if (typeof fetch !== \"function\") return null;\n  const apiHeaders = {\n    accept: \"application/json\",\n    \"api-user-agent\":\n      \"formal-ai-demo (https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai)\",\n  };\n\n  // When context is provided, first try a title-search to find the most\n  // relevant article slug (e.g. \"Kiss\" + \"рамках програмирования\" → \"KISS\n  // principle\"). }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Bare-term fallback: try direct slug variants without context.\n  const hosts = wikipediaHostsFor(language);\n  const variants = wikipediaTermVariants(term);\n  for (const host of (data.content_urls &&\n            data.content_urls.desktop &&\n            data.content_urls.desktop.page) ||\n          url;\n        return {\n          title,\n          extract,\n          url: Please clarify before I answer from that Wikipedia article.`;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Wikidata-backed fact reasoning pipeline (issue #127).\n//\n// Rather than matching against hardcoded summaries in `data/seed/facts.lino`,\n// fact questions (\"what is the capital of X?\", \"столица X\", \"X की राजधानी\",\n// \"X的首都\") are parsed into a structured query\n// `{ relation, subjectTerm, language, forceFresh }`. Keyed by `relation:subject_normalized:language`. The TTL\n// matches the user-requested 1 week. Pre-warmed from FACTS at init() so the\n// offline test matrix sees the same starting cache the Rust solver does.\nconst FACT_QUERY_CACHE = new Map();\nconst FACT_QUERY_TTL_MS = 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;\n\nfunction factCacheKey(relation, subjectTerm, language) {\n  return [\n    String(relation || \"\").toLowerCase(),\n    String(subjectTerm || \"\")\n      .toLowerCase()\n      .replace(/\\s+/g, \" \")\n      .trim(),\n    String(language || \"en\").toLowerCase(),\n  ].join(\":\");\n}\n\nfunction factCacheGet(relation, subjectTerm, language) {\n  const key = factCacheKey(relation, subjectTerm, language);\n  const entry = FACT_QUERY_CACHE.get(key);\n  if (!entry) return null;\n  if (\n    entry.expiresAt &&\n    typeof entry.expiresAt === \"number\" &&\n    entry.expiresAt < Date.now()\n  ) {\n    FACT_QUERY_CACHE.delete(key);\n    return null;\n  }\n  return entry;\n}\n\nfunction factCachePut(relation, subjectTerm, language, value) {\n  const key = factCacheKey(relation, subjectTerm, language);\n  const ttl = typeof value.ttlMs === \"number\" ? value.ttlMs : FACT_QUERY_TTL_MS;\n  const entry = Object.assign({}, value, {\n    expiresAt: Date.now() + ttl,\n  });\n  FACT_QUERY_CACHE.set(key, entry);\n  return entry;\n}\n\n// Pre-warm the runtime cache from the seed `facts.lino`. Each seed record can\n// optionally declare `relation`, `subjectQid`, `valueQid`, plus per-language\n// `subjectLabel`/`valueLabel`/`valueText` overrides — those are the structured\n// cache anchors. The legacy fields (`summary`, `subjectAliases`,\n// `questionKeywords`) remain in place for the `tryFactLookup` substring path.\nfunction warmFactCacheFromSeed() {\n  if (!Array.isArray(FACTS)) return;\n  const languages = [\"en\", \"ru\", \"hi\", \"zh\"];\n  for (const record of FACTS) {\n    if (!record || !record.relation || !record.subjectAliases) continue;\n    const localizedMap = new Map();\n    if (Array.isArray(record.localized)) {\n      for (const loc of record.localized) {\n        if (loc && loc.language) localizedMap.set(loc.language, loc);\n      }\n    }\n    for (const lang of languages) {\n      const loc = localizedMap.get(lang) || localizedMap.get(\"en\") || {};\n      const summary =\n        (loc && loc.summary) || record.summary || \"\";\n      const source = (loc && loc.source) || record.source || \"\";\n      const sourceKind =\n        (loc && loc.sourceKind) || record.sourceKind || \"wikipedia\";\n      const valueLabel = (loc && loc.valueLabel) || record.valueLabel || \"\";\n      const subjectLabel =\n        (loc && loc.subjectLabel) || record.subjectLabel || \"\";\n      // The aliases for the subject language drive cache key lookup. For each\n      // alias (already lowercased by seed_loader.js), pre-seed a cache entry.\n      const aliases = Array.isArray(record.subjectAliases)\n        ? record.subjectAliases\n        : [];\n      for (const alias of aliases) {\n        if (!alias) continue;\n        factCachePut(record.relation, alias, lang, {\n          relation: record.relation,\n          subjectTerm: alias,\n          subjectLabel: subjectLabel || alias,\n          subjectQid: record.subjectQid || \"\",\n          valueLabel,\n          valueQid: record.valueQid || \"\",\n          summary,\n          source,\n          sourceKind,\n          language: lang,\n          fromSeed: true,\n          ttlMs: FACT_QUERY_TTL_MS,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nasync function wikidataSearchEntity(term, language) {\n  if (typeof fetch !== \"function\") return null;\n  // Wikidata supports per-language search; English fallback ensures broad\n  // recall even for non-Latin scripts.\n  const ordered = [language, \"en\"].filter(\n    (value, index, array) => value && array.indexOf(value) === index,\n  );\n  for (const lang of ordered) {\n    const url = `${WIKIDATA_API}?action=wbsearchentities&format=json&origin=*&type=item&limit=5&language=${encodeURIComponent(\n      lang,\n    )}&search=${encodeURIComponent(term)}`;\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(url, {\n        headers: {\n          accept: \"application/json\",\n          \"api-user-agent\":\n            \"formal-ai-demo (https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai)\",\n        },\n      });\n      if (!response || !response.ok) continue;\n      const data = await response.json();\n      if (data && Array.isArray(data.search) && data.search.length > 0) {\n        const hit = data.search[0];\n        return {\n          qid: hit.id,\n          label: hit.label || term,\n          description: hit.description || \"\",\n          language: lang,\n        };\n      }\n    } catch (_error) {\n      // Try the next language.\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\nfunction wikidataConceptUrl(hit) {\n  const id = hit && hit.id ? We return a shared promise so concurrent\n// callers cooperate on the same probe batch.\nfunction ensureWebSearchProviderProbes() {\n  if (WEB_SEARCH_PROBE_PROMISE) return WEB_SEARCH_PROBE_PROMISE;\n  if (typeof fetch !== \"function\") {\n    WEB_SEARCH_PROBE_PROMISE = Promise.resolve([]);\n    return WEB_SEARCH_PROBE_PROMISE;\n  }\n  WEB_SEARCH_PROBE_PROMISE = (async () => {\n    const tasks = WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDERS.map((provider) => async () => {\n      if (!provider.probeUrl) return null;\n      const startedAt = Date.now();\n      try {\n        const response = await fetch(provider.probeUrl, { mode: \"cors\" });\n        const status = response ? Tasks are async functions returning a value; results are\n  // returned in the original order.\n  const cap = Math.max(1, Math.min(limit, tasks.length));\n  const results = new Array(tasks.length);\n  let cursor = 0;\n  async function worker() {\n    while (true) {\n      const index = cursor;\n      cursor += 1;\n      if (index >= tasks.length) return;\n      results[index] = await tasks[index]();\n    }\n  }\n  await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: cap }, () => worker()));\n  return results;\n}\n\nfunction reciprocalRankFusion(perProviderResults, k) {\n  // R194: the Rust/WASM core owns the fusion logic so the offline trace and\n  // the browser worker agree to the last byte. We try WASM first and only\n  // fall back to the JS implementation when the worker booted in\n  // `js fallback` mode (e.g. WASM disabled in the browser).\n  const wasmFused = wasmReciprocalRankFusion(perProviderResults);\n  if (wasmFused !== null) {\n    return wasmFused;\n  }\n  // Cormack, Clarke, Buettcher 2009: score(d) = Σ 1 / (k + rank_i(d)).\n  const fused = new Map();\n  for (const provider of perProviderResults) {\n    const list = Array.isArray(provider.results) ? provider.results : [];\n    list.forEach((item, index) => {\n      if (!item || !item.url) return;\n      const rank = index + 1;\n      const score = 1 / (k + rank);\n      const existing = fused.get(item.url);\n      if (existing) {\n        existing.score += score;\n        existing.providers.push({ id: provider.id, rank });\n        if (!existing.title && item.title) existing.title = item.title;\n        if (!existing.excerpt && item.excerpt) existing.excerpt = item.excerpt;\n      } else {\n        fused.set(item.url, {\n          url: item.url,\n          title: item.title || item.url,\n          excerpt: item.excerpt || \"\",\n          score,\n          providers: [{ id: provider.id, rank }],\n        });\n      }\n    });\n  }\n  return Array.from(fused.values()).sort((a, b) => {\n    if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;\n    return b.providers.length - a.providers.length;\n  });\n}\n\n// Issue #153/#180: identify \"the same entity\" returned by different providers\n// so the fused list shows one bullet with the other URLs collapsed under\n// \"Other sources:\". A single result can carry several canonical identifiers\n// (Wikidata Q-id, Wikipedia page key, Wiktionary headword) — dedupe walks all\n// of them and merges into the first existing group it finds. Returning a\n// list makes the Wikipedia↔Wikidata merge robust against percent-encoding\n// differences in the two providers' URLs.\nfunction canonicalEntityKeys(meta) {\n  if (!meta) return [];\n  const keys = [];\n  if (meta.qid && /^Q\\d+$/.test(meta.qid)) keys.push(`Q:${meta.qid}`);\n  if (meta.wikipediaKey) {\n    const lang = meta.wikipediaLanguage || \"en\";\n    keys.push(`WP:${lang}:${meta.wikipediaKey}`);\n  }\n  if (meta.wiktionaryKey) {\n    const lang = meta.wiktionaryLanguage || \"en\";\n    keys.push(`WT:${lang}:${meta.wiktionaryKey}`);\n  }\n  return keys;\n}\n\n// Backwards-compatible shim: prefer the primary key but keep the historical\n// single-key signature for callers that still rely on it.\nfunction canonicalEntityKey(meta) {\n  const keys = canonicalEntityKeys(meta);\n  return keys.length > 0 ? keys[0] : null;\n}\n\nfunction buildItemMetadataIndex(perProvider) {\n  // The richer the meta the better — an entry that carries a Wikidata `qid`\n  // is preferred over a Wikipedia-only entry for the same URL, because the\n  // Q-id is what cross-provider dedupe groups by. Without this preference,\n  // the Wikipedia URL would be indexed by the Wikipedia provider's meta\n  // (`WP:en:Apple`) and a separate Wikidata entry for the same fact (`Q:Q89`)\n  // would never collapse into one bullet.\n  const byUrl = new Map();\n  const rank = (item) => (item && item.qid ? 2 : 1);\n  function record(url, item) {\n    if (!url || !item) return;\n    const existing = byUrl.get(url);\n    if (!existing || rank(item) > rank(existing)) {\n      byUrl.set(url, item);\n    }\n  }\n  for (const provider of perProvider) {\n    if (!provider || !Array.isArray(provider.results)) continue;\n    for (const item of provider.results) {\n      if (!item || !item.url) continue;\n      record(item.url, item);\n      // Wikidata results carry the Wikipedia URL of the same entity inline;\n      // index that too so the Wikipedia provider's entry is recognised as\n      // a duplicate of the Wikidata one.\n      if (item.wikipediaUrl) record(item.wikipediaUrl, item);\n    }\n  }\n  return byUrl;\n}\n\nfunction dedupeFusedEntries(fused, metaByUrl, evidence) {\n  const groupsByKey = new Map();\n  const allGroups = [];\n  const standalone = [];\n\n  function alreadyHasProvider(target, candidate) {\n    return target.providers.some(\n      (existing) => existing.id === candidate.id && existing.rank === candidate.rank,\n    );\n  }\n\n  fused.forEach((entry, index) => {\n    const meta = metaByUrl.get(entry.url) || null;\n    const keys = canonicalEntityKeys(meta);\n    const enriched = Object.assign({}, entry, {\n      qid: (meta && meta.qid) || \"\",\n      wikipediaKey: (meta && meta.wikipediaKey) || \"\",\n      wikipediaLanguage: (meta && meta.wikipediaLanguage) || \"\",\n      wiktionaryKey: (meta && meta.wiktionaryKey) || \"\",\n      wiktionaryLanguage: (meta && meta.wiktionaryLanguage) || \"\",\n      sourceKind: (meta && meta.sourceKind) || \"\",\n      virtualId:\n        (meta && meta.virtualId) ||\n        (meta && meta.qid) ||\n        (meta && meta.wikipediaKey ? `WP:${meta.wikipediaKey}` : \"\"),\n      alternateUrls: [],\n      keys: keys.slice(),\n      originalRank: index,\n    });\n\n    if (keys.length === 0) {\n      standalone.push(enriched);\n      return;\n    }\n    let head = null;\n    for (const key of keys) {\n      if (groupsByKey.has(key)) {\n        head = groupsByKey.get(key);\n        break;\n      }\n    }\n    if (!head) {\n      allGroups.push(enriched);\n      for (const key of keys) {\n        if (!groupsByKey.has(key)) groupsByKey.set(key, enriched);\n      }\n      return;\n    }\n    // Found an existing group — absorb this entry into it.\n    head.score += enriched.score;\n    head.alternateUrls.push({\n      url: enriched.url,\n      title: enriched.title,\n      providers: enriched.providers,\n      sourceKind: enriched.sourceKind,\n    });\n    for (const p of enriched.providers) {\n      if (!alreadyHasProvider(head, p)) head.providers.push(p);\n    }\n    // Register the absorbed entry's keys against the head group too so a third\n    // provider matching either canonical id still merges in.\n    for (const key of keys) {\n      if (!groupsByKey.has(key)) groupsByKey.set(key, head);\n    }\n    // Prefer the richest virtualId once we know more identifiers.\n    if (!head.virtualId && enriched.virtualId) head.virtualId = enriched.virtualId;\n    if (!head.qid && enriched.qid) head.qid = enriched.qid;\n    if (!head.wikipediaKey && enriched.wikipediaKey) {\n      head.wikipediaKey = enriched.wikipediaKey;\n      head.wikipediaLanguage = enriched.wikipediaLanguage;\n    }\n    if (!head.wiktionaryKey && enriched.wiktionaryKey) {\n      head.wiktionaryKey = enriched.wiktionaryKey;\n      head.wiktionaryLanguage = enriched.wiktionaryLanguage;\n    }\n    if (Array.isArray(evidence)) {\n      evidence.push(`web_search:dedupe:${keys[0]}:absorbed:${enriched.url}`);\n    }\n  });\n  const merged = [...allGroups, ...standalone];\n  merged.sort((a, b) => {\n    if (b.score !== a.score) return b.score - a.score;\n    if (b.providers.length !== a.providers.length) {\n      return b.providers.length - a.providers.length;\n    }\n    // Issue #180: stable order by provider priority so DDG-led entries beat\n    // Wikidata-only entries on perfect ties.\n    const ap = providerPriorityScore(a.providers);\n    const bp = providerPriorityScore(b.providers);\n    if (ap !== bp) return ap - bp;\n    return a.originalRank - b.originalRank;\n  });\n  return merged;\n}\n\nfunction providerPriorityScore(providers) {\n  if (!Array.isArray(providers) || providers.length === 0) return 999;\n  let best = 999;\n  for (const p of providers) {\n    const score = WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER_PRIORITY[p && p.id] || 999;\n    if (score < best) best = score;\n  }\n  return best;\n}\n\n// Issue #153: {\n  const haystack = String(normalized || \"\").toLowerCase();\n  const raw = String(prompt || \"\");\n  const rawLower = String(prompt || \"\").toLowerCase();\n  for (const { verb, op } of fuzzyPrefixMatch(prompt, entry.verb);\n      return match ? Object.assign({ entry }, match) : null;\n    })\n    .filter(Boolean)\n    .sort((left, right) =>\n      left.typoCount - right.typoCount || right.end - left.end,\n    );\n  const best = matches[0];\n  if (!best) return null;\n  const peers = matches.filter(\n    (match) => match.typoCount === best.typoCount && match.end === best.end,\n  );\n  if (peers.length > 1) {\n    return {\n      ambiguous: true,\n      suggestions: peers.map((match) => match.entry.verb),\n      interpretations: [],\n    };\n  }\n  return {\n    op: best.entry.op,\n    verb: best.entry.verb,\n    objectText: String(prompt || \"\").slice(best.end),\n    interpretations: [best.interpretation],\n  };\n}\n\nfunction detectFormalizationMatch(prompt, normalized) {\n  return exactFormalizationMatch(prompt, normalized) || fuzzyFormalizationMatch(prompt);\n}\n\nfunction objectForFormalization(prompt, normalized, match) {\n  // For search-style ops we extract the explicit query the same way the web\n  // search handler does. contextRecord.aliases.some(\n      (alias) => normalizeConceptTerm(alias) === contextNormalized,\n    )\n  ) {\n    return true;\n  }\n  return (\n    Array.isArray(contextRecord.labels) &&\n    contextRecord.labels.some(\n      (label) => normalizeConceptTerm(label.text) === contextNormalized,\n    )\n  );\n}\n\nfunction resolveContextRecord(contextNormalized) {\n  if (!contextNormalized) 1] === right[j - 1]\n        ? dp[i - 1][j - 1]\n        : 1 + Math.min(dp[i - 1][j - 1], dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);\n      if (\n        i > 1 &&\n        j > 1 &&\n        left[i - 1] === right[j - 2] &&\n        left[i - 2] === right[j - 1]\n      ) {\n        dp[i][j] = Math.min(dp[i][j], dp[i - 2][j - 2] + 1);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return dp[m][n];\n}\n\nfunction isCloseTokenTypo(actual, expected) {\n  const left = String(actual || \"\").toLowerCase();\n  const right = String(expected || \"\").toLowerCase();\n  const leftLength = Array.from(left).length;\n  const rightLength = Array.from(right).length;\n  return Math.min(leftLength, rightLength) >= 4 && editDistance(left, right) === 1;\n}\n\nfunction leadingTokenSpans(value, limit) {\n  const text = String(value || \"\");\n  const spans = [];\n  const pattern = /\\S+/gu;\n  let match;\n  while ((match = pattern.exec(text)) !== null && spans.length < limit) {\n    spans.push({\n      start: match.index,\n      end: match.index + match[0].length,\n      text: match[0],\n    });\n  }\n  return spans;\n}\n\nfunction fuzzyPrefixMatch(value, prefix) {\n  const words = String(prefix || \"\").trim().split(/\\s+/u).filter(Boolean);\n  if (words.length === 0) return null;\n  const spans = leadingTokenSpans(value, words.length);\n  if (spans.length !== words.length) return null;\n  let typoCount = 0;\n  for (let i = 0; i < words.length; i += 1) {\n    const actual = spans[i].text;\n    const expected = words[i];\n    if (actual.toLowerCase() === expected.toLowerCase()) continue;\n    if (!isCloseTokenTypo(actual, expected)) return null;\n    typoCount += 1;\n  }\n  if (typoCount !== 1) return null;\n  const end = spans[spans.length - 1].end;\n  return {\n    typoCount,\n    end,\n    interpretation: {\n      original: String(value || \"\").slice(0, end),\n      corrected: String(prefix || \"\").trim(),\n    },\n  };\n}\n\nfunction stripKnownPrefix(value, prefixes) {\n  const text = String(value || \"\");\n  const lower = text.toLowerCase();\n  for (const prefix of prefixes) {\n    if (lower.startsWith(prefix)) {\n      return { value: text.slice(prefix.length).trimStart(), interpretation: null };\n    }\n  }\n  const matches = prefixes\n    .map((prefix) => fuzzyPrefixMatch(text, prefix))\n    .filter(Boolean)\n    .sort((left, right) =>\n      left.typoCount - part.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + part.slice(1) : part,\n    )\n    .join(\"\");\n}\n\nfunction wikipediaTermVariants(term) {\n  const seen = new Set();\n  const variants = [];\n  const push = (value) => {\n    if (!value) return;\n    const slug = String(value)\n      .trim()\n      .replace(/\\s+/g, \"_\")\n      .replace(/_+/g, \"_\");\n    if (!slug || seen.has(slug)) return;\n    seen.add(slug);\n    variants.push(slug);\n  };\n  const trimmed = String(term || \"\").trim();\n  push(trimmed);\n  push(capitalizeWords(trimmed));\n  push(capitalizeWords(trimmed.toLowerCase()));\n  push(trimmed.toLowerCase());\n  // Biography titles on Wikipedia (notably ru.wikipedia.org) use the\n  // \"Surname, Given names\" form: querying \"Илон Маск\" 404s, but \"Маск, Илон\"\n  // resolves. 0 : 1;\n      const next = Math.min(\n        previous[j] + 1,\n        current[j - 1] + 1,\n        previous[j - 1] + cost,\n      );\n      current[j] = next;\n      rowMin = Math.min(rowMin, next);\n    }\n    if (rowMin > limit) return limit + 1;\n    previous = current;\n  }\n  return previous[right.length];\n}\n\nfunction isNearLookupText(left, right) {\n  const a = compactLookupText(left);\n  const b = compactLookupText(right);\n  if (!a || !b) return false;\n  const maxLength = Math.max(a.length, b.length);\n  const limit = maxLength <= 8 ? 1 : 2;\n  return boundedEditDistance(a, b, limit) <= limit;\n}\n\nfunction isPlausibleWikipediaSearchMatch(summary, term) {\n  if (\n    !summary ||\n    (summary.matchKind !== \"search\" && summary.matchKind !== \"context_search\")\n  ) {\n    return true;\n  }\n  const termNormalized = normalizeLookupText(term);\n  if (!termNormalized) return true;\n  const termTokens = termNormalized.split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean);\n  const candidates = [\n    summary.title,\n    summary.matchedTitle,\n    String(summary.matchedSlug || \"\").replace(/_/g, \" \"),\n    summary.extract,\n  ];\n  for (const candidate of candidates) {\n    const normalized = normalizeLookupText(candidate);\n    if (!normalized) continue;\n    if (normalized === termNormalized) return true;\n    const candidateTokens = new Set(normalized.split(/\\s+/).filter(Boolean));\n    if (\n      termTokens.length > 0 &&\n      termTokens.every((token) => candidateTokens.has(token))\n    ) {\n      return true;\n    }\n    if (isNearLookupText(termNormalized, normalized)) return true;\n  }\n  return false;\n}\n\n// Resolve a context-qualified term to a Wikipedia page slug via full-text page\n// search. Tries multiple query formulations (uppercase term, mixed case) on the\n// detected language host then on English, returning the first match found.\n// This helps disambiguate short acronyms like \"KISS\" or \"DRY\" when the user\n// provides a programming/domain context.\nasync function searchWikipediaSlug(term, context, language) {\n  if (typeof fetch !== \"function\") return null;\n  const apiHeaders = {\n    accept: \"application/json\",\n    \"api-user-agent\":\n      \"formal-ai-demo (https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai)\",\n  };\n  const upper = term.toUpperCase();\n  // Build candidate queries in preference order: uppercase term with context is\n  // most discriminating; plain term with context is the fallback.\n  const queries = [];\n  if (upper !== term) queries.push(`${upper} ${context}`.trim());\n  queries.push(`${term} ${context}`.trim());\n  const ordered = [language, \"en\"].filter(\n    (value, index, array) => value && array.indexOf(value) === index,\n  );\n  for (const lang of ordered) {\n    const base = WIKIPEDIA_SEARCH_HOSTS[lang] || WIKIPEDIA_SEARCH_HOSTS.en;\n    for (const query of queries) {\n      const url = `${base}?q=${encodeURIComponent(query)}&limit=5`;\n      try {\n        const response = await fetch(url, { headers: apiHeaders });\n        if (!response || !response.ok) continue;\n        const data = await response.json();\n        if (!data || !Array.isArray(data.pages) || data.pages.length === 0)\n          continue;\n        // Return the key of the top result; callers will fetch the full summary.\n        const page = data.pages[0];\n        return {\n          slug: page.key,\n          title: page.title || page.key,\n          language: lang,\n          query,\n        };\n      } catch (_error) {\n        // Ignore and try next query / language host.\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\nasync function fetchWikipediaSummary(term, language, context) {\n  if (typeof fetch !== \"function\") return null;\n  const apiHeaders = {\n    accept: \"application/json\",\n    \"api-user-agent\":\n      \"formal-ai-demo (https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai)\",\n  };\n\n  // When context is provided, first try a title-search to find the most\n  // relevant article slug (e.g. \"Kiss\" + \"рамках програмирования\" → \"KISS\n  // principle\"). This prevents ambiguous short terms from matching the wrong\n  // article (e.g. the rock band instead of the software design principle).\n  if (context) {\n    const found = await searchWikipediaSlug(term, context, language);\n    if (found) {\n      const summaryBase =\n        WIKIPEDIA_HOSTS[found.language] || WIKIPEDIA_HOSTS.en;\n      const url = `${summaryBase}/${encodeURIComponent(found.slug)}`;\n      try {\n        const response = await fetch(url, { headers: apiHeaders });\n        if (response && response.ok) {\n          const data = await response.json();\n          if (\n            data &&\n            typeof data === \"object\" &&\n            data.type !== \"disambiguation\"\n          ) {\n            const extract = String(data.extract || \"\").trim();\n            if (extract) {\n              const title = String(data.title || term);\n              const pageUrl =\n                (data.content_urls &&\n                  data.content_urls.desktop &&\n                  data.content_urls.desktop.page) ||\n                url;\n              return {\n                title,\n                extract,\n                url: pageUrl,\n                language: found.language,\n                matchKind: \"context_search\",\n                matchedSlug: found.slug,\n                matchedTitle: found.title || title,\n                searchQuery: found.query || \"\",\n              };\n            }\n          }\n        }\n      } catch (_error) {\n        // Fall through to bare-term lookup below.\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // Bare-term fallback: try direct slug variants without context.\n  const hosts = wikipediaHostsFor(language);\n  const variants = wikipediaTermVariants(term);\n  for (const host of hosts) {\n    for (const slug of variants) {\n      const url = `${host.url}/${encodeURIComponent(slug)}`;\n      try {\n        const response = await fetch(url, { headers: apiHeaders });\n        if (!response || !response.ok) continue;\n        const data = await response.json();\n        if (!data || typeof data !== \"object\") continue;\n        if (data.type === \"disambiguation\") continue;\n        const extract = String(data.extract || \"\").trim();\n        if (!extract) continue;\n        const title = String(data.title || term);\n        const pageUrl =\n          (data.content_urls &&\n            data.content_urls.desktop &&\n            data.content_urls.desktop.page) ||\n          url;\n        return {\n          title,\n          extract,\n          url: pageUrl,\n          language: host.language,\n          matchKind: \"direct\",\n          matchedSlug: slug,\n        };\n      } catch (_error) {\n        // Swallow network/parse errors and continue to the next variant.\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  // All direct slug variants were disambiguation pages or not found. Use the\n  // full-text search endpoint to find the top-ranked article for the term\n  // (e.g. \"tesla\" → \"Tesla, Inc.\" instead of the disambiguation page).\n  const found = await searchWikipediaSlug(term, \"\", language);\n  if (found) {\n    const summaryBase = WIKIPEDIA_HOSTS[found.language] || WIKIPEDIA_HOSTS.en;\n    const url = `${summaryBase}/${encodeURIComponent(found.slug)}`;\n    try {\n      const response = await fetch(url, { headers: apiHeaders });\n      if (response && response.ok) {\n        const data = await response.json();\n        if (\n          data &&\n          typeof data === \"object\" &&\n          data.type !== \"disambiguation\"\n        ) {\n          const extract = String(data.extract || \"\").trim();\n          if (extract) {\n            const title = String(data.title || term);\n            const pageUrl =\n              (data.content_urls &&\n                data.content_urls.desktop &&\n                data.content_urls.desktop.page) ||\n              url;\n            return {\n              title,\n              extract,\n              url: pageUrl,\n              language: found.language,\n              matchKind: \"search\",\n              matchedSlug: found.slug,\n              matchedTitle: found.title || title,\n              searchQuery: found.query || \"\",\n            };\n          }\n        }\n      }\n    } catch (_error) {\n      // Search-based fallback failed; return null below.\n    }\n  }\n  return null;\n}\n\nfunction isClosestWikipediaMatch(summary) {\n  return summary && summary.matchKind === \"search\";\n}\n\nfunction closestMatchNote(summary, language) {\n  const title = summary && summary.title ? summary.title : \"the top result\";\n  if (language === \"ru\") {\n    return `Ближайшее совпадение по поиску Wikipedia: «${title}». Уточните, отвечать по этой статье Wikipedia?`;\n  }\n  if (language === \"zh\") {\n    return `你是指“${title}”吗？请确认后我再根据这篇 Wikipedia 文章回答。`;\n  }\n  if (language === \"hi\") {\n    return `क्या आपका मतलब \"${title}\" था? Please clarify before I answer from that Wikipedia article.`;\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Wikidata-backed fact reasoning pipeline (issue #127).\n//\n// Rather than matching against hardcoded summaries in `data/seed/facts.lino`,\n// fact questions (\"what is the capital of X?\", \"столица X\", \"X की राजधानी\",\n// \"X的首都\") are parsed into a structured query\n// `{ relation, subjectTerm, language, forceFresh }`. The query is then\n// resolved against:\n//\n//   1. An in-memory cache (1-week TTL) keyed by `relation:subject:language`.\n//      The cache is pre-warmed from the seed `FACTS` entries so the test\n//      matrix stays deterministic offline.\n//   2. Wikidata `wbsearchentities` to resolve the subject term to a Q-ID.\n//   3. Wikidata `wbgetentities` to fetch the property claim (P36 = capital,\n//      P1082 = population, P38 = currency, P37 = official language, P30 =\n//      continent, P2046 = area, P35 = head of state, P6 = head of government).\n//   4. Detected in all\n// four supported languages plus a couple of common English phrasings.\nconst FORCE_FRESH_MARKERS = [\n  \"fresh\",\n  \"no cache\",\n  \"no-cache\",\n  \"without cache\",\n  \"skip cache\",\n  \"ignore cache\",\n  \"refresh\",\n  \"не из кэша\",\n  \"не из кеша\",\n  \"без кэша\",\n  \"без кеша\",\n  \"обнови\",\n  \"свежий ответ\",\n  \"свежие данные\",\n  \"ताज़ा\",\n  \"ताज़े\",\n  \"बिना कैश\",\n  \"नया जवाब\",\n  \"刷新\",\n  \"新鲜\",\n  \"不要缓存\",\n  \"不用缓存\",\n];\n\nfunction shouldForceFresh(normalized, prompt) {\n  const lowerPrompt = String(prompt || \"\").toLowerCase();\n  return FORCE_FRESH_MARKERS.some(\n    (marker) => normalized.includes(marker) || lowerPrompt.includes(marker),\n  );\n}\n\n// Multilingual relation patterns.
